facts.text: Most undergraduate students at Biola complete 30 credits of Bible and theology coursework as part of the core curriculum, qualifying for a minor in biblical and theological studies.

sources.title: Core Curriculum: Bible and Theology Courses - Biola University
sources.quote: As part of Biola's academic core curriculum, most undergraduate students complete 30 credits of Bible and theology courses, qualifying most to receive a minor in biblical and theological studies.
